tts.step1: What matters most to you to live a more fulfilling life?
tts.step2: Healthy sleep is the foundation of a fulfilling life. Good sleep habits help you live well and make it easier to enjoy precious family time, financial breathing room, an energetic daily routine, emotional stability, and physical health.
tts.step3: Take a moment to reaffirm your commitment to healthy sleep habits. Answer how important sleep habits are, and write one small action you can take today.

step1.description_001: For the next 16 days, we will continue the 'Build Healthy Sleep Habits' project.
step1.description_002: To build healthy sleep habits, you first need to think about the values and goals that matter most in your life.

step2.title: Hello, I am your sleep coach.
step2.subtitle: Healthy sleep becomes the <1>foundation of a fulfilling life</1>.
step2.body: Good sleep habits help you live a healthy life and make it easier to realize many important values in life, such as time with family, financial flexibility, an active daily routine, emotional stability, and physical health.

step3.mission: Revisit your values and commit to building healthy sleep habits
